title: 1987 Topps - Dave Righetti #40 New York Yankees MLB Baseball Card - Set Of 2
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1987 Topps Dave Righetti #40 New York Yankees MLB baseball card set of 2. These standard-sized trading cards are made of card stock with a thickness of 20 Pt. They are original, not autographed, and feature the player Dave Righetti in his New York Yankees uniform from the 1987 MLB season. Manufactured by Topps in the United States, these English-language cards are part of the base set and are a must-have for any baseball card collector.
